hook_line: INFOSYS, TCS AND COGNIZANT SLASH H-1B ENTRIES

hook_stat.sub: Fall in eligible H-1B registrations in the FY2027 lottery

stats.label: Infosys registrations for FY2027, down from 8,886
Cognizant cut — no FY2027 registrations, down from 3,752

diaspora_bullets: Entry-level hires face the steepest decline in chances
Highest wage level gets four lottery entries, lowest gets one
news_summary: Infosys, TCS and Cognizant submitted 91%, 95% and 100% fewer H-1B registrations for the fiscal 2027 lottery than for fiscal 2026, according to a Congressional Research Service report.
payoff: Selection now rewards higher-wage offers, so entry-level roles face sharply worse odds.
